start: Live workout open, a weight-and-reps exercise card (for example Bench Press) with planned sets

steps.action: Type weight and reps into set 1 and tick it
user_sees: The row turns done; the rest timer starts with the exercise's rest time
must_not: The tick lost when scrolling
Rest starting for an unticked row

steps.action: Tap 'Add set'
user_sees: A new set row under the last one, hinted from the target
must_not: The new row placed above ticked sets
Two rows added by one tap

steps.action: Tap the card's more button ('More for <name>'), then 'Add note', type 'seat height 6'
user_sees: A note box (placeholder 'Note, e.g. seat height 6') with the text
must_not: The note saved onto another exercise

steps.action: Open the menu, tap 'Rest timer', pick 2:00
user_sees: Sheet 'Rest timer', subtitle 'For <name>. Remembered for next time.'; the card shows the new rest
must_not: The rest closing as if kept when saving it failed

steps.action: Finish the workout later
user_sees: The sets, note and rest are in the saved workout
must_not: Ticked sets missing from the saved workout

start: Live workout, exercise card with a working weight entered

steps.action: Open the menu and tap 'Add warm-up sets'
user_sees: Warm-up rows ('W') added above the working sets; on a barbell none below the empty bar
must_not: Warm-ups heavier than the working weight
Warm-ups counted as working sets in the target

steps.action: Open the second card's menu and tap 'Move up'
user_sees: The card moves to first place and scrolls into view
must_not: Sets moving to another exercise

steps.action: Open the menu, tap 'Superset', pick the next exercise
user_sees: Both cards get an orange left edge and a 'Superset A' badge
must_not: A superset with only one exercise left showing a badge

steps.action: On a superset card, the menu says 'Move superset up'
user_sees: The whole superset moves together
must_not: The superset split apart by a move

steps.action: Open the menu, tap 'Swap exercise' (value 'This workout')
user_sees: A sheet of alternatives for this workout only
must_not: The routine changed for next time

steps.action: Pick an alternative
user_sees: The card now shows the new exercise; ticked sets stay with the old one
must_not: Ticked sets moved onto the new exercise

steps.action: For a member's own exercise, tap 'Swap exercise'
user_sees: The full exercise picker opens instead
must_not: An empty alternatives list

start: Live workout, an exercise with a counting choice (for example a dumbbell move)

steps.action: Open the menu, tap 'Counting', pick another way
user_sees: The card's weights are counted the new way in this workout only
must_not: Past workouts re-counted

start: Live workout, exercise card with no working weight entered

steps.action: Open the menu and tap 'Add warm-up sets'
user_sees: A message 'Set a working weight first' - 'Enter a weight on a working set, then add warm-up sets.'
must_not: Warm-up rows of 0 kg added

steps.action: Open the menu and tap 'Plate calculator'
user_sees: The locked-feature pop-up explaining the calculator is part of MettleUp Plus, with a way to the Plus screen
must_not: The calculator opening for free
The workout lost on going to the Plus screen

start: Live workout, swap pick fails (the alternative cannot be found in the library)

steps.action: Pick an alternative in the swap sheet
user_sees: A message 'Could not swap' - 'Please try again.'
must_not: The card emptied or the old exercise removed

start: Live workout, an exercise with two ticked sets

steps.action: Open the menu, tap 'Remove exercise'
user_sees: Pop-up 'Remove exercise?' - 'Remove <name> and its sets from this workout.' with a red 'Remove'
must_not: The exercise removed without asking

steps.action: Tap Cancel
user_sees: The card and its sets stay
must_not: Sets removed anyway

steps.action: Do it again and tap 'Remove'
user_sees: The card is gone from the workout
must_not: The removed exercise still saved on Finish

start: Live workout, a set was deleted

steps.action: Delete a set row, then tap Undo
user_sees: The set comes back in its place; its rest timer is not restarted
must_not: The set coming back at the wrong place
A rest started by that set kept running after the delete

steps.action: Delete a set, then add warm-up sets
user_sees: Undo is no longer offered for that exercise
must_not: Undo putting the set back at a shifted place

start: Live workout, member is in a gym that uses MettleUp

steps.action: Log sets and a note, then finish
user_sees: The note and sets stay with the member; the gym sees only what 'What my gym can see' says
must_not: The note, body weight or photos sent to the gym
Exercises sent to the gym without the member's switch
